0.headline: 'Kerala Story' producer Sunshine Pictures to launch Rs 282-crore IPO next week, sets price band at Rs 342-360 per share
0.heading: 'Kerala Story' producer Sunshine Pictures to launch Rs 282-crore IPO next week, sets price band at Rs 342-360 per share
0.intro: Sunshine Pictures IPO | The company is raising up to Rs 172.8 crore by issuing 48 lakh fresh equity shares, while promoters will be selling 30.37 lakh shares worth up to Rs 109.33 crore via offer-for-sale.
0.body:
Vipul Shah's Mumbai-based film production company Sunshine Pictures will open its maiden public issue amounting to Rs 282.1 crore for subscription on August 18, with a price band of Rs 342-360 per share.

The company that produced movies like Kerala Story, Commando, Holiday, and Force 2 is raising up to Rs 172.8 crore by issuing 48 lakh fresh equity shares, while promoter and producer Vipul Amrutlal Shah and his wife and actress Shefali will be selling 30.37 lakh shares worth up to Rs 109.33 crore via offer-for-sale.

The IPO size has been reduced by the company. Sunshine Pictures had filed draft papers with SEBI in December 2024 to raise funds via IPO that comprised of fresh issue of 50 lakh shares, and an offer-for-sale of 33.75 lakh shares. The said IPO papers were cleared by the capital markets regulator in June 2025.

The one-day anchor book will be launched on August 17, while the IPO will open for public subscription on August 20. The IPO share allotment is expected to be finalised by August 21, while the trading in its equity shares is likely to commence on the stock exchanges on August 25.

Half of the offer size has been reserved for qualified institutional buyers, while the 35 percent portion is allocated for retail investors, and the remainder 15 percent for non-institutional investors.

Incorporated in 2007, the company, which is seeking a market capitalisation of Rs 1,121.4 crore at the upper end of price band, is a production-house originating, developing, and marketing and distribution of films, TV serials and web series.

Click Here To Read All IPO News

Sunshine Pictures intends to utilise Rs 112.5 crore of net fresh issue proceeds for its working capital requirements, and the remaining amount for general corporate purposes.

Bids can be made by investors for a minimum of 41 equity shares, and in multiples of 41 shares thereafter. The minimum investment by retail investors in the offer would be Rs 14,760, and the maximum would be Rs 1,91,880.

On the financial front, Sunshine Pictures has recorded standalone profit of Rs 40.02 crore and revenue of Rs 74.4 crore for the fiscal year ended March 2026.

On consolidated basis, profit fell 35.4 percent to Rs 34.5 crore in the year ended March 2025 from Rs 53.3 crore in previous year. Revenue during the same period also dropped 22.8 percent to Rs 103.3 crore from Rs 133.8 crore.

The merchant banker appointed for managing the Sunshine Pictures is GYR Capital Advisors.

1.headline: Technocraft Ventures IPO: Issue subscribed over 5x so far on Day 3; latest GMP here
1.heading: Technocraft Ventures IPO: Issue subscribed over 5x so far on Day 3; latest GMP here
1.intro: The initial public offering (IPO) of wastewater treatment and infrastructure solutions provider Technocraft Ventures continued to attract strong investor interest on the last day of bidding, with the issue subscribed 5.15 times as of 10:08 am on August 11, according to data available on the NSE.
1.body:
The initial public offering (IPO) of wastewater treatment and infrastructure solutions provider Technocraft Ventures continued to attract strong investor interest on the last day of bidding, with the issue subscribed 5.15 times as of 10:08 am on August 11, according to data available on the NSE.

The Rs 251.88-crore IPO received bids for 4,27,94,080 equity shares against 83,17,190 shares on offer. The non-institutional investor (NII) portion was subscribed 7.48 times, while the retail portion was subscribed 4.52 times.

The issue opened for subscription on August 7 and will close today, August 11. The price band has been fixed at Rs 200-212 per share.

Read Also: Shiprocket IPO GMP rises to 28% ahead of August 12 issue opening; check lot size, timeline and key details

The company had raised Rs 75.55 crore from anchor investors on August 6, a day before the IPO opened for subscription. It allotted 35.63 lakh equity shares at Rs 212 apiece. The anchor book included LRSD Securities, Vikasa India EIF I Fund, Nakshatra Bharat Vantage Fund and Venus Stellar Fund.

The grey market premium (GMP) for the Technocraft Ventures IPO stood at Rs 30 on August 11, according to InvestorGain. At the upper end of the IPO price band of Rs 212, the GMP indicates an estimated listing price of around Rs 242, translating into a potential premium of 14.15 percent.

Investors must note that the GMP is an unofficial indicator of market sentiment and does not guarantee the actual listing price or listing gains.

The Technocraft Ventures IPO comprises a fresh issue of 95.05 lakh equity shares and an offer for sale (OFS) of 23.76 lakh shares by promoter entity Kartikey Constructions.

The company plans to use Rs 150 crore from the net proceeds of the fresh issue to meet its working capital requirements. The remaining proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes.

Khambatta Securities is the book-running lead manager for the issue. The IPO is scheduled to be listed on BSE and NSE on August 14.

Check IPO News Here

Technocraft Ventures reported a net profit of Rs 43.3 crore in FY26, up 53.6 percent from Rs 28.2 crore in FY25. Revenue from operations increased 23.4 percent year-on-year to Rs 345 crore from Rs 279.6 crore.

The company had an unexecuted order book worth Rs 1,320.7 crore as of July 15, 2026. This includes operation and maintenance contracts that are scheduled to be executed after completion of the related projects.

About Technocraft Ventures

Technocraft Ventures undertakes water and wastewater infrastructure projects, primarily for state governments and government agencies across northern and central India. The company operates in areas including water supply, wastewater treatment and other infrastructure projects, with government and government-linked entities forming a significant part of its customer base.

Water and wastewater projects accounted for nearly 85 percent of the company's revenue in FY26, while road and highway projects contributed around 13 percent.

2.headline: Hillhouse-backed managed workspace provider Table Space files IPO papers to raise Rs 800 crore via fresh issue
2.heading: Hillhouse-backed managed workspace provider Table Space files IPO papers to raise Rs 800 crore via fresh issue
2.intro: Table Space IPO | Promoter AGS TS II Holdings Pte, owned by Hillhouse Investment, will be the largest seller among the selling shareholders, offloading up to 4.98 crore shares through the OFS.
2.body:
Bengaluru-based managed workspace provider Tablespace Technologies, backed by Singapore-based global alternative investment manager Hillhouse Investment, has filed a draft red herring prospectus (DRHP) with the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) to raise Rs 800 crore through a fresh issue, along with an offer-for-sale (OFS) of 6.54 crore equity shares.

Promoter AGS TS II Holdings Pte, owned by Hillhouse Investment, will be the largest seller among the selling shareholders, offloading up to 4.98 crore shares through the OFS. Individual promoters Karan Chopra and Kunal Mehra, along with Srinivas Prasad, Narendra Kumar Kamaraju, RSP Real Estate LLP and Ramachandra Venkatasubba Rao, will be the other selling shareholders in the OFS.

Tablespace Technologies may also consider raising up to Rs 160 crore through a pre-IPO round, i.e. before filing the red herring prospectus with the Registrar of Companies. This amount will be part of the fresh issue component. Therefore, if the company raises funds through a pre-IPO placement, the amount raised will be reduced from the fresh issue size.

Currently, Hillhouse Investment holds a 41.76 percent stake in the company, followed by Amit Mono Banerji with a 22.14 percent stake and Karan Chopra with a 12.47 percent stake.

Table Space specialises in providing premium managed workspace solutions through a portfolio comprising 11.46 million square feet of leasable area across 33 key office clusters in eight Tier-1 cities in India: Bengaluru, Mumbai Metropolitan Region (MMR), Hyderabad, Gurugram, Chennai, Pune, Noida and New Delhi.

Click Here To Read All IPO News

The company proposes to utilise Rs 550 crore of the fresh issue proceeds to repay debt, against total outstanding borrowings of Rs 970.6 crore as of June 2026. The remaining proceeds will be utilised for inorganic growth through unidentified acquisitions and general corporate purposes.

Table Space, which competes with listed peers such as Smartworks Coworking Spaces, Indiqube Spaces, Awfis Space Solutions and WeWork India Management, reported a loss of Rs 403.3 crore for the year ended March 2026, narrowing significantly from a loss of Rs 1,554.1 crore in the previous year.

Revenue during the same period increased sharply by 66.3 percent to Rs 2,262.3 crore from Rs 1,360.5 crore.

Axis Capital, BofA Securities India, CLSA India, IIFL Capital Services and JM Financial have been appointed as the merchant bankers for the Tablespace Technologies IPO.
